messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT: gpu-pool-backlog > 95% (queue depth 18k) in us-west-2, autoscaler failing to provision. Pager: @tony (oncall). Severity: P1.

ton y (oncall): on it. joining bridge now — can someone paste the most recent autoscaler logs?

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-8421. Bridge: https://meet.redwood/incident/PD-8421. Escalation: tony -> rachel.

sam (eng-runtime): i see lots of CUDA Xid 31/43 spikes in the driver logs on nodes gpu-node-8..12. frequent OOMs on model-worker pods too. attaching tail:
```
/var/log/driver/gpu-driver.log: tail -n 80
[13:02:11] Xid 31: GPU page fault, resetting context
[13:02:12] GPU OOM: alloc failed for 28 GiB
[13:02:14] container "model-worker" killed (OOM)
[13:02:16] kubelet: eviction threshold reached, pod evicted
```

rachel (eng-sre): autoscaler keeps hitting quota limit when requesting new instances: cloud API returns 402/QuotaExceeded for g4dn.xlarge in us-west-2. logs:
```
autoscaler: request_capacity -> cloud.request_instances(10)
cloud: 402 QuotaExceeded: "Insufficient capacity for instance type"
autoscaler: retrying, backoff 30s
```

kevin (infra): confirmed — experimental capacity pool is full in us-west-2. we have a soft limit with cloud of 120 GPUs, currently at 118 allocated but many are in unusable state (driver crashed / flapping).

jasmine (support): we have alerts from two customers reporting 5xxs and increased latency: acme-inc (prod) and nocturne.ai (staging->prod spill). Customer success on the bridge.

ton y (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) stop new requests to the affected GPU pool (route to backup region/us-east) 2) drain flapping nodes, restart driver, 3) force-autoscale fallback to CPU workers for low-priority queues, 4) prepare customer comms. executing 1 now.

maya (prod): routing switch command issued to edge-router:
```
POST /routes/reload
{ "route": "model-gpu-us-west", "fallback": "model-gpu-us-east,model-cpu-fallback", "drain_ms": 30000 }
```

incident-bot: routing change applied, 80% traffic diverted to us-east, 20% to cpu-fallback for egress. watch latency.

sam (eng-runtime): starting targeted remediation on nodes 8-12: rolling restart of nvidia-driver + restart kubelet on each. doing one at a time. first node draining now: kubectl cordon/gdrain.

rachel (eng-sre): autoscaler still retrying; i'll temporarily raise max_nodes hard-limit from 120 -> 140 with infra approval, but that won't help if cloud capacity is exhausted. kevin, can you confirm quota bump request?

kevin (infra): requested capacity increase with cloud support, ∼T+45m ETA. in parallel i'll try to identify dormant reserved instances in other pools we can reprovision.

sam (eng-runtime): after restarting driver on gpu-node-9 we saw reduced Xid spikes and two model-worker pods recovered. metrics: GPU utilization down from 95% to 68% on that node, queue depth locally decreased.

jasmine (support): notifying affected customers: acme-inc notified via status page and email; msg: "We're mitigating a GPU capacity issue causing elevated latency/5xxs for some requests in us-west-2. Traffic is being routed to other regions; we will update in 30 minutes."

ton y (oncall): summary for bridge: immediate mitigation = routing fallback + driver restarts + draining flappers. medium term = quota bump + reconfigure autoscaler to prefer warm standby nodes and reduce single-pool blast radius. long term = prioritize KV caching to reduce per-token compute.

rachel (eng-sre): note — we observed several nodes reporting ephemeral kernel panics followed by GPU reset, likely driver bug triggered by high-mem allocation patterns. filing runtime bug: RUNTIME-3789. tagging sam + runtime-eng.

sam (eng-runtime): adding a temporary pod-safety limit: reduce per-pod max-batch-size and enable model quantization profile 'p95-safemode' for the high-QPS endpoints so they consume less VRAM. patch applied to canary route.

pagerduty-bot: PD-8421 acknowledged by tony (oncall). Estimated next update in 15 minutes.

jasmine (support): update: acme-inc reported throughput improved after routing change, but nocturne.ai still sees 503s for long contexts. continuing diagnostics.

kevin (infra): found 4 underutilized GPU instances in eu-west which we can cold-migrate but it'll take ~25min. starting migration orchestration.

sam (eng-runtime): observed autoscaler backoff loop due to cloud rate-limits; added exponential backoff jitter and increased healthcheck window to reduce flapping. pushing change now.

rachel (eng-sre): oncall handoff schedule — tony will hand off to maya in 45m for overnight monitoring. leaving bridge open until backlog < 2k and driver Xid errors are cleared cluster-wide.

ton y (oncall): thanks all. major actions taken logged in incident doc: https://docs.redwood/incidents/PD-8421. next: prepare post-incident customer writeup and RCA.

incident-bot: Incident PD-8421 — status: mitigated -> traffic reroute + node remediation in progress. Next update at 2067890723."
